name: Winstar Display Co., Ltd.
summary: Winstar Display Co., Ltd., based in Taichung City, Taiwan, is a prominent global provider specializing in the production, refinement, and sale of a diverse array of display solutions and modules. Established in 1998, the company's reach extends internationally, with significant operations across Europe, Asia, and the United States. The company boasts a comprehensive product portfolio encompassing various display technologies. This includes a wide selection of Thin-Film Transistor Liquid Crystal Displays (TFT LCDs), such as standard color, IPS (In-Plane Switching), high-brightness, wide-temperature, bar-type, and monochrome options, often featuring HDMI signal compatibility or integrated touch panels and controller boards. Winstar also pioneers in Organic Light-Emitting Diode (OLED) technology, offering graphic, character, touch-enabled displays, and innovative OLED knob interfaces. Their offerings further extend to intelligent display modules utilizing CAN, RS485, and UART communication protocols, alongside entry-level UART TFTs. Additionally, they provide a range of traditional graphic and character LCDs, including Chip-on-Glass, VATN (Vertically Aligned Twisted Nematic), and field sequential color types. Specialized products like electronic paper displays (EPD) and coding systems are also part of their line-up. Beyond standard products, Winstar offers bespoke custom LCD designs and comprehensive system integration services. These advanced display technologies cater to a broad spectrum of industries, including medical, transportation, electric vehicle (EV) charging, entertainment, architecture, general industrial applications, energy, and retail sectors.
